g.text: Natural isolation and mapped port proximity provide different comparisons
GSHHG 2.3.7 L1 islands ≥5 km²; WPI 2025: 3,688 usable entries. 120 islands with unresolved Antarctic comparison excluded.
Spherical coast samples ≤1 km apart; axes linear below 1 km, logarithmic above. Three remote islands straddle the 50 km port threshold.
WPI lists major ports, not all harbors; nearby entries may be on other landmasses. Geographic support only, no butterfly or shipping effect.
